verdict.rationale: cubic supports auto-approval of PRs meeting a review policy and custom agents/org rules that enforce best practices, which can indirectly gate merges via GitHub branch protection combined with cubic's approval status, but there is no direct documentation of cubic itself acting as a required status check or blocking review tied to unresolved critical findings. missing for 10: explicit required-status-check/blocking-review integration, documentation of how unresolved critical findings block merge, and independent confirmation that auto-approval/custom agents are used as a formal merge gate.
